caption: Caribou bull in summer velvet. Tall rack with a shovel over the face, white neck mane, brown coat. Cows grow antlers too.

caption: Plains bison bulls in Yellowstone in snow. Next to a wood bison the hump is lower and the front end hair is longer and shaggier.

caption: Snowshoe hare in its brown coat, Banff. Grey brown body, dark ear tips, big dark eye.

caption: Snowshoe hare in its white winter coat. Look at the huge furred hind feet: the snowshoes.

caption: Shiras moose bulls in velvet, Utah: the small southeast race.

caption: Bull in deep snow: long legs carry it over drifts and brush.

caption: Old park photo, Isle Royale: a moose that lost most of its winter hair. Pale, patchy coat.

caption: Bull in early summer: new antlers, short and covered in velvet.

caption: Rocky Mountain elk bull, Banff: tan body, dark mane, pale rump patch.

caption: Young bulls (spikes) running: one or two tips on each antler.

caption: Newborn elk calf, Grand Teton: spotted coat, wobbly long legs.

caption: Bull in summer velvet: antlers soft, fuzzy and still growing.

caption: Bull bugling on a frosty September morning. Breath shows in the cold.

caption: Bulls bedded on open winter range, Montana.

caption: Bull in winter coat: pale body, thick dark mane on the neck.

caption: Young mule deer buck in velvet, Sun Peaks near Kamloops, early summer.

caption: Young black tailed buck, Vancouver Island: short antlers in velvet.

caption: Two bucks sparring in the fall rut.
author: Harpers Ferry National Historical Park

caption: White (Kermode or Spirit) phase black bear, Klemtu, BC. Never legal to hunt.

caption: Black sow with two blue grey (Glacier phase) cubs, Alaska. One family, three colours.

caption: Yearling black bear, Glacier Bay: in its second year. Never legal.

caption: Spot the cubs: two small black shapes up the trunk. Garibaldi Park, BC.

caption: Black bear facing you: tall ears, straight tan muzzle, short claws.

author: Unknown (1909 book plate)

caption: Sow and newborn cubs in a winter den.
author: National Park Service

caption: Black bear skull from the front: short wide muzzle, big canine teeth.
author: Acroterion

caption: Black bear in Yoho National Park, BC: straight face, tall ears, no hump.

caption: Young brown phase black bear on a tree: short curved claws grip the bark.

caption: Young black bear searching for food on a rocky slope.

caption: Black bear head on: tall ears, straight muzzle, pale chest patch.

caption: Black bear eating devil's club berries, southeast Alaska.

caption: Brown phase black bear (a sow), Quesnel Lake, BC: straight face, tall ears, no shoulder hump.

caption: Young white tailed deer in winter near Fort St. John, BC: grey brown winter coat.

caption: Mule deer from behind, Penticton: white rump patch, thin tail with a black tip.

caption: Mule deer doe in summer, Trophy Mountain meadows near Clearwater, BC.

caption: Cow and calf in a wetland, Bowron Lake Park, BC.

caption: Moose country: a slough with sedge and willow, Bowron Lake Park, BC. Find the moose.

caption: Cow with a red brown newborn calf, northern BC, spring.

caption: Cow and calf standing in water.
author: Eric Kilby

caption: Bulls sparring in the timber, Jasper National Park.
author: Jeffrey Pang

caption: Cow and calf at the forest edge, Jasper National Park.
author: Thomas Fuhrmann

caption: Mature bighorn ram in winter. Heavy brown horns curling back, down and forward toward a full circle.

caption: Stone's sheep ram on rock. Dark grey brown body, white rump and belly, curled amber horns.

caption: Mountain goat. White shaggy coat, short black horns, beard on the chin.

caption: Mountain goat nanny with her kid on a cliff top. A nanny with a kid at her side is easy to spot.

caption: Mule deer buck. Note the big ears, forked antlers and the thin white tail with a black tip.
author: GlacierNPS

author: Matt Reinbold from USA

caption: Mule deer doe, front view. No antlers, huge ears, pale face with a dark forehead.

caption: White tailed doe, side view, in snow. Brown back, long brown tail, smaller ears than a mule deer.

author: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Headquarters

caption: Mule deer doe and two fawns from behind. Big white rump patches, thin rope tails with black tips.

caption: Mule deer doe and fawn half hidden in brush. In cover you often see only ears and a face.
author: USFWS Mountain-Prairie

caption: Mule deer at distance in sagebrush, eastern Oregon. Grey bodies, white rumps and big ears are what you pick out first.
author: BLM Oregon & Washington

caption: Mule deer fawn bedded and hiding in grass. Its mother is close by. Leave it alone.
author: USFWS Mountain Prairie

caption: Mule deer fawn in summer, North Dakota. White spots on a red brown coat; the spots fade by fall.
author: James St. John

caption: White tailed deer buck, side view, New Jersey. Brown tail with white edges, antler tines rising from one main beam.

author: Famartin

caption: White tailed deer bounding away on open prairie, Montana. Running long and low, tails up, not the stiff legged bounce of a mule deer.
author: NPS

author: Jacob W. Frank

caption: Bull moose, front view, Grand Teton. Antlers spread wide like two open hands; heavy bulbous nose.

caption: Young bull moose with small spike and fork antlers, Grand Teton. Measure carefully: young bulls are often not legal.
author: GrandTetonNPS

caption: Cow moose feeding in a lake, Glacier National Park. No antlers, long pale legs, brown body.

author: GrandTetonNPS

caption: Bull elk looking back. Note the straw coloured rump patch and the dark neck.
author: NPS Photo

caption: Bull elk at distance in snow, National Elk Refuge, Wyoming. Pale bodies and dark necks stand out a long way off.

caption: Cow elk, Glacier National Park. No antlers, long neck, darker head and neck than the body.
author: GlacierNPS

caption: Cow elk from behind, Firehole River, Yellowstone. The big pale rump patch is the elk signature.

caption: Cow elk herd in winter, Yellowstone. Elk live in herds; check every animal before you pick one.

caption: Pale brown black bear along the Dempster Highway, Yukon. Even this light coat sits on a black bear body shape.

author: NPS/Jim Peaco

caption: Mule deer buck from behind, Colorado. Big white rump patch and a thin rope tail with a black tip.
